title: Analyst, Infrastructure
description:
Press Tab to Move to Skip to Content Link

Select how often (in days) to receive an alert: Create Alert

GIC is one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 offices around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world’s industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore’s financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.
Infrastructure
We deploy long-term capital through direct, and fund investments across the capital structure to diversify our portfolio. You will help to preserve and enhance the value of our direct private and public equity investments, working with top management teams and board of directors.

The Sao Paulo team was established in 2015, and currently has nine investment professionals. The team is focused on analyzing opportunities in South and Central America, as well as managing the investments made since 2013 in the region. It is integrated into the global team which operates from London, New York, Singapore and Sao Paulo.

Illustrative investments include Aegea (water and sanitation in Brazil), CART/Eixo SP (toll roads in Brazil), V.tal (fiber optics in Brazil), Neoenergia Transmission (power transmission in Brazil), NTS (gas pipeline in Brazil) and Isagen (power generation in Colombia), amongst others. GIC Infrastructure approaches investments with a buy and hold perspective and manages assets with a long-term perspective. We focus on minority / co-control investments alongside industrial and financial partners and have consolidated ourselves as one of the most active investors in the sector and region.

We are looking for a suitable candidate to join our Sao Paulo team as an Analyst. GIC desires to become the leading long term global infrastructure investor and an outstanding career path is available for high performers.
What impact can you make in this role
You will be part of a team that invests into infrastructure companies with stable and predictable cash flows, reasonable risk-adjusted returns and strong impact to local economies.

What you will do as an Analyst
• Play a central role in growing GIC Infrastructure’s portfolio and supporting existing investments in the region.
• Under the supervision of the senior team, play an integral role in the full deal lifecycle: deal screening, approvals, execution, asset management and, when appropriate, exits.
• Take on primary role in the financial modeling of transactions, deal with senior management, external advisors and banks.
• Play a key part in deal screening and appraisal, contributing to transaction analysis, and helping prepare the documentation to support investment decisions to investment committee.
• Investment focus is likely to be biased towards, but not limited to, the power, midstream, transportation, digital infrastructure and water utility sectors. No experience in infrastructure sectors is required, but the candidate will be required to conduct financial research on public and private companies for potential acquisitions.
• The team operates in a flat and meritocratic culture, empowering staff with open communications and robust challenges. Being a team player and interacting with counterparties in a way that builds on our reputation is everyone’s responsibility.
What makes you a successful candidate?
• Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier university with coursework emphasizing business administration, economics, accounting, finance, and/or engineering. Graduation date between June 2024 and June 2025.
• Previous experience working for a private equity fund, institutional investors, or for investment banks as part of the M&A advisory or Equity research team. Experience in the infrastructure sector is not required.
• Outstanding financial modelling skills are assumed and will be tested. The ability to build models from scratch is required, as well as model review and scenario development.
• You will be detail-oriented with a hands-on attitude to deal execution and will thrive in a culture of high-expectations and personal responsibility to own the investment.
• Strong commercial and intellectual curiosity is a requirement to perform well and advance.
Work at the Point of Impact
We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-Term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.
Flexibility at GIC
At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office at least four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

We are an equal opportunity employer
As an employer, we passionately believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of GIC teams to drive competitive performance. An inclusive environment yields exceptional contribution.

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A . está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.

Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

Área responsável pelas atividades centrais de planejamento de demanda e pela sua execução para uma Unidade de Negócio e região. Atua em parceria com o time Comercial da BU para captar as principais prioridades do negócio e lidar com as exceções geradas pelo sistema de previsão em primeira instância e alçada. Responsável pela parametrização das variáveis que impactam a demanda no sistema.

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Responsável pela execução do planejamento de demanda por cliente, incluindo as atividades do S&OP, como: coleta e execução de prioridades da BU, geração de previsões estatísticas, identificação de sinais de demanda, gestão de desvios e resolução de problemas;
  • Realiza análises e relatórios de resultados do forecast (consumo, alertas de tendência gerados pelo sistema, acurácia e viés da previsão, análise de causas de erro) e faz ajustes ou ações corretivas para eliminar desvios;
  • Utiliza técnicas estatísticas (como séries temporais, regressão linear, entre outras) para construir planos de demanda base, sem restrições. Conduz análises de portfólio sob a perspectiva do planejamento, recomendando otimizações e racionalização de SKUs;
  • Responsável pelos indicadores de performance da demanda, como acurácia da previsão (MAPE), viés, variabilidade da demanda, assertividade de promoções, entre outros, seguindo os padrões da empresa;
  • Responsável pela coleta e correto uso dos parâmetros necessários para realizar o planejamento de demanda adequado (logística, fornecedores, itens).

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Forte experiência e proficiência em planejamento de demanda e análise de portfólio aplicados à cadeia de suprimentos, com foco no setor-alvo;
  • Alta capacidade analítica e quantitativa, com habilidade para interpretar e gerenciar grandes volumes de dados;
  • Experiência com modelagem estatística de previsões e elaboração de orçamentos de vendas (sales budgeting).

Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

  • Conhecimento no Sistema Relex.

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos e-mails e no spam.

  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Allya: app que oferece descontos em quase 30 mil estabelecimentos por todo Brasil, ex: farmácia, restaurante, salão, academia, etc;

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas , de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Tätigkeitsprofil:

Das Colégio Visconde de Porto Seguro ist eine deutsche Auslandsschule, deren Abschlüsse von der KMK in Deutschland anerkannt werden. Die Schule wird von der Bundesrepublik Deutschland als Begegnungsschule gefördert und ist von der Ständigen Konferenz der Kultusminister (KMK) zur Abhaltung von Prüfungen der allgemeinen deutschen Hochschulreife (Abitur) ermächtigt. Mit zwei aufeinander abgestimmten Bildungsplänen sind sowohl deutsche als auch brasilianische Abschlüsse anerkannt und möglich.

Unsere freundlichen und sehr motivierten Schülerinnen und Schüler lernen in zwei Kulturkreisen, bereits vom Kindergarten an. So erwerben sie erweiterte Kenntnisse über Werte, Normen, Geschichte und Mentalität eines anderen Landes.

Es wird eine Stelle in Vollzeit angeboten. Das Deputat umfasst 26 Stunden pro Unterrichtswoche. Neben dem Unterricht ist die Bereitschaft zur Mitarbeit in schulischen Gremien sowie Engagement bei außerunterrichtlichen Veranstaltungen erwünscht.

Die Tätigkeit umfasst:

  • Klassenleitung
  • Fachunterricht in den Klassenstufen 5-12
  • Mitarbeit in der Unterrichts- und Schulentwicklung

Anforderungsprofil:

Gesucht werden engagierte Lehrkräfte, die Freude am pädagogischen Umgang mit Kindern haben und über Sozialkompetenz, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und freundliches Auftreten verfügen. Erforderlich sind hohe Flexibilität, Aufgeschlossenheit, Motivation sowie Teamfähigkeit und Interesse am kulturellen Umfeld (Brasilien/Südamerika). Die Beherrschung der Landessprache (Portugiesisch) ist keine Einstellungsvoraussetzung, wird aber während des Arbeitsverhältnisses begrüßt und gefördert.

  • Lehrbefähigung in Fach Kunst und idealerweise einem abiturrelevanten Zweitfach (z.B. Deutsch, Englisch, Mathematik, Geschichte, Philosophie, Biologie, Chemie, Physik)
  • Bewerber(innen) müssen über das 1. und 2. Staatsexamen (Lehramt) oder einen vergleichbaren Abschluss verfügen
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit digitalen Medien als Unterrichtswerkzeug
  • Überdurchschnittliche Einsatzbereitschaft, Neugier und Arbeitsfreude
  • Teamfähigkeit, Flexibilität, Belastbarkeit
  • Idealerweise Unterrichts- und Projekterfahrung in der gymnasialen Oberstufe

Sie erwartet ein hochinteressantes Arbeitsumfeld in einem motivierten, netten Team.

Die Vergütung richtet sich nach der gültigen Gehaltsrichtlinie der Schule und liegt im Landesvergleich überdurchschnittlich. Weitere Leistungen wie Krankenversicherung, Lebensversicherung und Mietzuschuss sind enthalten. Bei Zuzug aus dem Ausland erhalten Sie eine Umzugspauschale sowie eine Flugkostenpauschale.

Bewerbungsverfahren und Kontakt:

Bitte senden Sie Ihre vollständige Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, Foto, Zeugniskopien und Kontaktdaten per E-Mail unter Angabe der Position und Kennziffer in der Betreffzeile. Nutzen Sie für die Anhänge vorzugsweise das PDF-Format und senden Sie idealerweise nur eine Gesamtdatei.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

From great products to long-lasting companies, we believe that nothing great is made alone—comemake with us!

Figma is looking for a Manager, Commercial Sales to join our dynamic team of creatives, engineers, marketing wizards, and brilliant business folks. You aren’t the typical sales leader, and we aren’t the typical design tool company. At Figma we think outside the box, lift constraints that block our imagination everyday and we expect you to do the same. With this role you’ll get in at the ground floor in a fast growing sales org. You’ll consult with our existing customer base and potential customers in driving meaningful relationships that add value to the customer experience and revenue to our bottom line.

Figma is growing and moving fast. Our next team member will have an agile, dynamic mindset, be comfortable embracing change, a true team-player, and love working with our growing footprint of Fortune 1000 customers. You won’t be alone! Figma has an incredible team and you’ll work closely with other groups including Support, Design, Engineering, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Community. As Manager, Commercial Sales, you will lead a team of Account Executives responsible for continuing the growth of our SMB and MId-Market products.   • Lead a team of motivated and diverse individuals to foster an environment of success
  • Participate in customer and prospect meetings
  • Assist in continual training and development, including mentorship, hiring and career growth
  • Help shape and further develop sales processes and initiatives
  • Interview, hire and train new team members as we scale the business and company

  • Ability to thrive in a constantly changing and evolving environment
  • Exceptional coaching, writing, discovery and presentation skills

  • Proven track record of leading successful and consistent sales team

title: Backend Software Engineer Specialist
description:
About Digibee

Digibee is an iPaaS that scales integration workflows while reducing cost and technical debt. Rather than require specialized integration experts, Digibee lets every developer quickly build, test, deploy, govern, and monitor integrations across on-premise and cloud environments using a simple but powerful low-code interface.

Founded in São Paulo, Brazil, in 2017 and headquartered in Weston, Florida, our team is widely distributed throughout the Americas. In May of 2023, Digibee closed a Series B funding round of $60 million that is intended to drive our expansion in the United States.

About the role

We're looking for a Backend engineer to contribute disruptive ideas to our Integration Platform, making it robust and scalable. The candidate must be very rigorous in decisions and in developing clean, secure, and sustainable code.

On a typical day, you will…

  • Participate in discussions about architectural solutions and what would be the best methods to solve a given problem;
  • Conduct maintenance and development of new features from beginning to end using best programming practices;
  • Collaborate with the development team to analyze requirements and transform them into efficient solutions.

What You'll Need To Bring...

  • 2+ years of experience in software development using Java;
  • Experience using Spring or Quarkus;
  • Experience in developing distributed solutions using microservices, messaging, and streaming;
  • Unit Testing (Cucumber: BDD Testing);
  • Experience in agile models (Scrum/Kanban);
  • Experience in developing solutions using NoSQL databases (MongoDB and ElasticSearch) and Relational Databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, and/or Oracle);
  • Experience with Git version control.

It's a plus if you have...

  • Experience in developing solutions based on Open Container, Kubernetes, and Cloud Computing;
  • Knowledge in Kotlin and Go programming languages;
  • Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment;

Are you ready to go the extra mile to create an impact?

Do you want to be challenged with engaging work every day, pushing your boundaries?

Do you want to be surrounded by dedicated and passionate people who care about each other and the world we live in?

If all of your answers are yes, then you are in the right place.

description:
Sales Trader de Renda Variável (Curitiba)

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório deagentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grandeecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra,determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente:Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande:Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta:Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor:Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

O nosso propósito é transformar o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas. Começamos em 2001, como um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre. Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de pessoas talentosas que, por meio da nossa cultura de Sonho Grande, Mente Aberta e Espírito Empreendedor, tiveram a autonomia e liberdade que precisavam para transformar o mercado financeiro.

Porém, sabemos que o desafio é muito maior. Os grandes bancos ainda possuem 95% do mercado de investimentos no Brasil, mas estamos aqui para romper essa lógica e melhorar a vida de muito mais pessoas. Somos exatamente o que o sistema financeiro nunca foi.

Se você se identifica com esses conceitos e deseja construir algo especial, mergulhe de cabeça nesta oportunidade.

Sobre a oportunidade

Como Sales Trader, você irá atuar auxiliando nossos clientes mais relevantes nas tomadas de decisão no universo da renda variável, levando em consideração o momento de mercado, a visão do nosso time de research e o perfil de cada investidor. Buscamos pessoas extremamente organizadas, além habilidades técnicas e comerciais a fim de desenvolver um trabalho de excelência junto a nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa em construção, então aqui o aprendizado é constante e você terá pista livre para criar e muitos (muitos mesmo!) desafios. Além disso, você trabalhará ao lado de pessoas diversas e talentosas que irão te ajudar a usar todo o seu potencial e gerar o maior impacto possível.

Alguns dos desafios que você vai encarar:

  • Transmitir recomendações de operações de curto, médio e longo prazo, de acordo com o perfil do cliente;
  • Execução de operações nos mercados à vista, futuro e a termo;
  • Assessoria na montagem de operações estruturadas;
  • Contato ativo com os maiores clientes de renda variável da XP para acompanhamento de posição e atualização de cenário de mercado; (alternativa: contato ativo com clientes que possuam carteira de ações acima de R$ 300 mil)
  • Atuar como referência técnica para clientes e assessores no universo de renda variável.

// O que buscamos

Pré-requisitos para candidatura:

  • Estar habituado em colocar o cliente no centro de nossas decisões;
  • Curiosidade em Renda Variável;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo 100% presencial em Curitiba;

Desejável, mas não eliminatório:

  • Experiência prévia em mesa de operações;
  • Certificação CPA-20.

“Se te oferecem um lugar em um foguete, não pergunte qual é o assento, apenas embarque.”

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass , Zenklub , VA, VR, New Value , seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia .

title: Senior FP&A Analyst
description:
About Digibee
Digibee is an iPaaS that scales integration workflows while reducing cost and technical debt. Rather than require specialized integration experts, Digibee lets every developer quickly build, test, deploy, govern, and monitor integrations across on-premise and cloud environments using a simple but powerful low-code interface.

Founded in São Paulo, Brazil, in 2017 and headquartered in Weston, Florida, our team is widely distributed throughout the Americas. In May of 2023, Digibee closed a Series B funding round of $60 million that is intended to drive our expansion in the United States.

About the role

We are looking for a highly skilled FP&A analyst to join our team. As a senior FP&A Analyst, you will play a critical role in managing financial planning and analysis activities, providing insights to senior management, and supporting investor relations efforts. This role requires strong analytical capabilities, financial modeling expertise, and excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders effectively.
We offer a dynamic, fast-paced environment with high-level exposure to different initiatives and projects.

On a typical day, you will…

  1. Review the monthly financial statement.
  2. Interact with the investors, being responsible for dealing with their ad hoc analysis.
  3. Conduct financial modeling and scenario analysis to evaluate strategic initiatives, investment opportunities, and business performance metrics.
  4. Develop and enhance financial measurement reporting tools.
  5. Prepare and coordinate internal and monthly reports.
  6. Prepare ad hoc analysis to support strategic decision-making.
  7. Measure and analyze the KPIs, interact with other departments to understand the current scenario, and provide this view.
  8. Prepare financial viability analysis of new investments.
  9. Lead the development of financial forecasts, budgets, and long-range plans in collaboration with functional teams.
  10. Perform variance analysis to assess financial performance against budget, forecast, and prior periods, identifying key drivers and trends for P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash-Flow.
  11. Prepare insightful financial presentations and reports for senior management and the board of directors, highlighting key performance metrics, risks, and opportunities.
  12. Support investor relations activities, including preparation of quarterly earnings materials, investor presentations, and responding to inquiries from analysts and investors.
  13. Drive process improvements and efficiencies in financial planning and analysis processes, leveraging technology and automation tools where appropriate.
  14. Stay abreast of industry trends, competitive landscape, and regulatory developments to inform financial analysis and decision-making.

What You'll Need To Bring

  1. Bachelors in business administration, engineering, economics, accounting or similar.
  2. 5+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis, investment banking, or related roles.
  3. Knowledge of the main Financial Statements: Balance sheets, P&L and Cash Flow.
  4. Experience in Financial Modeling.
  5. Fluency in English.
  6. Advanced Excel skills.
  7. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with ability to distill complex financial concepts into clear and concise messages for diverse audiences.
  8. Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and senior leadership.
  9. Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

What is nice to have

  1. Experience in SaaS Industry.
  2. VBA preferred.
  3. SQL / Python.
  4. Experience with investor relations (preferred).

Our perks and benefits

  1. We're remote first, with a flexible working schedule.
  2. Health care and Odonto Plan.
  3. R$ 1.200,00/month on Caju card (for food and meal allowance, mobility, home office supplies, culture, health, and education).
  4. Life insurance.
  5. Child care assistance.
  6. Gympass.
  7. English course: we have a partnership for group classes for R$100 monthly.

Our culture

We believe in a highly collaborative work environment in order to foster constant development and exchange between teams. We encourage learning, sharing knowledge, and using new technologies to create disruptive ideas - we want to create something great together!

At Digibee, we know it's our people who make the difference. We embrace and value diversity and are dedicated to encouraging a supportive and respectful culture in our community.

title: Lead Applied Machine Learning Scientist
description:
Are you excited about working at the forefront of applied research in an industry setting? Thomson Reuters Labs in São Paulo is seeking scientists with a passion for solving problems using state-of-the-art information retrieval, natural language processing, and generative AI.

What does Thomson Reuters Labs do?

We experiment, build, and deliver. We support the organization and our customers through applied research in informational retrieval and natural language processing. We work closely with product and domain experts to identify compelling solutions at the intersection of user need and technical feasibility. Our team is designing the next generation of search technology for Legal and Tax Professionals globally. We drive AI innovation for Thomson Reuters.

About the Role

Lead Applied Scientists are experts in Machine Learning / NLP, responsible for designing and delivering AI solutions that enhance Thomson Reuters' products. They leverage information retrieval techniques, prompting workflows, model training, and evaluation design to build and optimize solutions. Their work ensures AI technologies are effectively aligned with business objectives, driving product innovation and value.

As a Lead Applied Scientist, you will:

  1. Innovate and drive solution delivery as a technical leader
  2. Be fully accountable for all research deliverables
  3. Provide input to the business and Labs leadership on long-term AI strategy
  4. Lead and drive stakeholder engagement with other functions (UX, Product, Tech)

Senior P&E Solution Architect - SCM SAP Digital Manufacturing and SAP Integrated Business Planning

At SAP, we enable you to bring out your best. Our company culture is focused on collaboration and a shared passion to help the world run better. How? We focus every day on building the foundation for tomorrow and creating a workplace that embraces differences, values flexibility, and is aligned to our purpose-driven and future-focused work. We offer a highly collaborative, caring team environment with a strong focus on learning and development, recognition for your individual contributions, and a variety of benefit options for you to choosefrom.

PURPOSE AND OBJECTIVES

SAP Digital Manufacturing is a critical mission application for our customers who produce anything from food to electronics, medical instruments or automotive parts. Our cloud service must be extremely reliable and run our customers’ shop floor operations with high performance in discrete and process manufacturing industries around the world.

SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP) is used by more than 1000 customers globally across 24 industries as the primary supply chain planning application. Key business processes supported include Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Planning, Sales and Operations Planning, along with others.

As a Product &Engineering Solution Architect who is part of our SAP S/4HANA Product Experience - Cloud ERP Product Success team, you will transform our market and accelerate our momentum for our Cloud products.

Our team is responsible for the execution of our strategy, scope and the product experience for SCM SAP Digital Manufacturing. We focus on unlocking the right capabilities of our digital core with the needed focus to scale the business.

You will have impact and contact by bridging between our customer demand, our sales priorities and our product definition and development units. Customer adoption for SCM SAP Digital Manufacturing and SAP IBP with the rollout of new functionality will be an important part of your daily role.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

You will collaborate with our customers, Implementation Partners, Field Sales, Field Services, Product Teams, Support Teams, and Development Teams across SAP to:

  • Keep track of your customer engagements and work with Customers and Services to assess and prioritize requests during the implementation of SAP Digital Manufacturing Dispatching & Execution and SAP IBP in the Americas Region, focusing on the Latin America countries.
  • Increase the success of SAP’s market-leading cloud-based manufacturing solution by providing powerful automation capabilities easy to configure, deploy and monitor across different manufacturing sites.
  • You will be working with your empowered product team to discover and deliver delighting innovations based on opportunities and problems to be solved , defined by the overall product vision and strategy. With a data-driven approach you can manage, and increment features delivered to drive adoption within the customer base.
  • Manage (understand, analyze and categorize) individual customer demand for the of SAP Digital Manufacturing Dispatching & Execution and SAP IBP in a regional setup , assuring one face to the customer from Product Success and Product Experience.
  • Work with Product and Development teams to compile SAP’s product roadmap based on customer feedback.
  • Be the voice of the product for Customers, Sales and Presales by advocating solution readiness and innovations to drive adoption of SAP Digital Manufacturing Dispatching & Execution and SAP IBP.
  • Prepare and conduct expert testing on planned and future functionality of SAP Digital Manufacturing Dispatching & Execution along with cross-functional products that will deliver the SAP Intelligent Enterprise Suite.

Your impact and support of our deliverables on the strategy of our innovations will be key via:

  • Experience in working with clients in analyzing and transferring market and client demand directly into the Product Management/Development teams (functional specification, co-innovation, etc.).
  • Excellent ability to liaise with the different internal organizations (Development, Preferred success organization, Customer first organization, Field, etc.), becoming a key counterpart for stakeholders in Product Management / Development organization.
  • Outstanding project management skills to align with the respective areas and drive projects successfully along tight deadlines.

EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS/ SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

  • Bachelor’s in Computer Science or Business Administration (Engineering) or comparable education required.
  • Relevant experience in software innovation projects, product management, support and customer facing roles (e.g. Functional consultant, solution architect, support, presales).
  • Strong experience in professional software development. Relevant working experience in the SAP environment.
  • Domain knowledge in manufacturing, planning , and/or logistics combined with strong analytical skills and technical expertise of SAP BTP based cloud solutions.
  • Domain knowledge in supply chain planning processes
  • Experience working with multiple stakeholders from cross functional teams in multiple regions/time zones.
  • Ability to distill technical information fast and prepare stakeholder specific content out of it, with the business outcome in mind and customer focus; ability to simplify complex information.
  • Experience in product definition (ideally close to a Product Owner role), alternatively: Proven track record in or on collaboration with Product Development and/or Product Management and/or Solution Management
  • Excellent communication and language skills in Portuguese, Spanish and English (spoken and written)
  • Strong interpersonal , coordination, communication and presentation skills.

Preferred skills

  • Deep understanding of the Cloud architecture and SaaS model.
  • Experience as a Subject Matter Expert in a functional area like Logistics or Manufacturing is a plus.
  • MBA or master’s degree in related field is desired.
  • Design thinking expertise welcome but not mandatory.
  • Good knowledge of Cloud principles
  • Activate Methodology is a plus
  • ERP Business Processes Knowledge
  • Experience in co-innovation processes would be a plus

The Manufacturing Dispatching & Execution team empowers manufacturers with the tools necessary to produce high-quality products consistently, comply with regulatory requirements, achieve operational transparency, ensure full traceability of materials and processes, and support sustainable practices. This holistic approach not only enhances operational efficiency but also builds customer trust and satisfaction across the board.

SAP IBP brings core supply chain planning processes into a common platform, allowing for consistency in data, collaboration between teams, and seamless integration to ERP. Benefits of IBP include: reduced inventory investments, improved customer service levels, reduced operational costs, and improved collaboration both internally and with the customer’s suppliers and customers.

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP,you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do hospital conta com dez andares, distribuídos entre emergência, unidades de terapia intensiva (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal, maternidade, clínica médica, cirurgia geral, bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos na Zona Oeste, região atendida pelo hospital, há duas enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial, dispondo de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções graves em pacientes com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, com 39 leitos, que absorve demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII livre para casos de risco de morte, cirurgias urgentes e internações. Este CER possui atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades:

  • Prestar atendimento nas enfermarias, centro cirúrgico e Unidade de Terapia Intensiva do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Medicina.
  • Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista na área.
  • Registro ativo no conselho de classe.
  • Experiência mínima de 6 (seis) meses comprovada na função.

O hospital está localizado em Santa Cruz - RJ. A carga horária varia entre 10h, 12h e 24h semanais, dependendo da vaga.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviço, com vínculo de parentesco ou atuação em diferentes modalidades contratuais, devem consultar as normativas de RH vigentes junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma entidade civil sem fins lucrativos, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, atuando em vários níveis na gestão de serviços e organizações de saúde, com foco na promoção da saúde e na prevenção de doenças, atendendo a todos sem discriminação.

A organização busca expandir suas ações na área social e educacional, consolidando-se como uma grande instituição filantrópica que busca sustentabilidade social, econômica e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, instituições afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são geridas por profissionais altamente capacitados, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos serviços do SUS, garantindo acesso universal e de qualidade à saúde, apoiada por equipes multiprofissionais qualificadas.

O PAIS , iniciado em 2001 em São Paulo, estende-se a outros municípios e estados, buscando melhorar indicadores de saúde e a qualidade de vida, pautado nos princípios de integralidade e equidade, com gestão estratégica e aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM promove oportunidades de trabalho para pessoas com deficiência, com planos de carreira e anúncios periódicos divulgados nos principais jornais das regiões onde atua.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica e compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, garantindo atendimento de qualidade em todos os níveis de assistência para a população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Foco nas análises e projeções de custos de produção e venda. Identificar desvios, riscos e oportunidades através das análises “planejado vs. realizado”, gerando informações detalhadas e em tempo hábil, para suportar o processo decisório.

PARA JUNTOS ALCANÇARMOS O EXTRAORDINÁRIO, VOCÊ SERÁ RESPONSÁVEL POR:

  • Responsável pela projeção e acompanhamento dos custos de curto, médio e longo prazos, por país (Brasil, Argentina, Chile e Paraguai);
  • Elaborar bridges dos cenários financeiros de custos e disponibilização à liderança executiva da empresa;
  • Calcular impactos de FX (câmbio) e Inflação nos diversos cenários financeiros analisados;
  • Desenvolver, consolidar e analisar as informações de custos para exercícios de fechamento mensal e trimestral, Budget, Forecast e Planejamento Estratégico;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com outros departamentos nas projeções e explicações das variações (Suprimentos, Logística, Contabilidade, entre outros...);
  • Construir, manter e aprimorar modelos financeiros para realização de análises ad-hoc;
  • Responsável pela elaboração de relatórios financeiros e KPI’s estratégicos da área;
  • Responsável por apresentar análises através de documentos estruturados e com foco no resultado;

PARA JUNTOS FAZERMOS A DIFERENÇA ESPERAMOS QUE VOCÊ TENHA

  • Formação superiorcompleta em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas afins;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office | Excel avançado (essencial);
  • Matemática Financeira;
  • Conhecimento em Custos (CPM/CPV | COGM/COGS);
  • Conhecimento em Contabilidade;
  • Conhecimento de SAP;
  • Diferencial com conhecimento em sistemas BI.

A Ball Corporation é uma empresa de oportunidades iguais. Incentivamos ativamente inscrições de todas as pessoas, independentemente de sexo, idade, etnia, fé, habilidade ou orientação.

Ao ingressar na Ball, você pertence a uma equipe de mais de 22.000 membros em todo o mundo. Nosso produtos vão desde latas de alumínio infinitamente recicláveis, copos e garrafas de aerosol, que permitem que nossos clientes tenham uma compreensão mais profunda do nosso planeta e do universo.

Senior Developer - SAP Concur Cloud Services

At SAP, we enable you to bring out your best. Our company culture is focused on collaboration and a shared passion to help the world run better. How? As a Senior Software Development Engineer on our team, you will:

  • Solve complex problems and design systems that enable best-in-class operation of SAP Concur’s cloud services and communications with our customers.
  • Develop across the full-stack on a variety of technologies including Python, Lambda, Boto client, SQS, Sceptre, Cloud Custodian, Dynamo, Docker containers, Kubernetes and AWS ECS.

description:
Description

Provide knowledge, leadership, insight and direction for broking activities to ensure that clients’ expectations are regularly met. This role incorporates a wide level of expertise, but always assumes the broker is capable of handling accounts independently. The size and complexity of the account can vary. More experienced brokers may be responsible for training and supervising Associate Brokers. Responsible to ensure that relevant regulatory and technical standards are met. Helps drive the broking team to achieve agreed operational and financial goals and objectives.

Note that visa employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity

The Role

  • Orchestrate new business placement, renewals and alterations of existing coverage.
  • Develop, review and deliver presentations to secure new, and build on existing, relationships.
  • Review and evaluate information and analytics to assess and evaluate client risks to support the placement of client risks in the market.
  • Research and evaluate all solutions (insurance and otherwise) to identify and develop optimum risk solutions for clients.
  • Provide coverage and program design advice and expertise to client; perform needs and gap analysis to make recommendations regarding program improvements.
  • Build strong partnerships with a broad range of organizations and stakeholders in the market in order to secure optimum terms and conditions for clients.
  • Contribute to thought leadership and continuous process improvement of the Broking function.
  • Work closely with associates to stay on top of changes in the marketplace.
  • Oversee design and preparation of draft proposals; negotiate and finalize of carrier quotes, terms and conditions and coverage confirmations to ensure contract certainty.
  • Bind carrier quotes and review binders and coverage confirmations.
  • Request / Attend and participate in regular client and underwriter meetings.
  • Conduct program peer reviews.
  • Provide coaching to brokers in training.

Qualifications

The Requirements
• 5-12 years industry experience (real estate, hospitality and leisure industry experience preferred but not required)
• Insurance broker’s P&C license required
• Strong group presentation skills (written and verbal); ability to drive complex/technical conversations
• Relationship management: customer focus, collaboration, interpersonal skills, and conflict management; demonstrates shared ownership of resolution of conflicts
• Negotiation skills: carrier and client negotiation skills; can secure concessions without damaging relationships
• Business acumen: demonstrates knowledge of industries and clients, carriers, and/or markets
• Project management: ability to effectively manage and oversee small projects
• Receptive to feedback; critical thinking and problem-solving skills; high adaptability
• Leadership skills: applies judgment in making decisions, directs and motivates others, takes lead in small groups, and promotes teamwork
This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.

Compensation and Benefits
Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation (Producer roles only).


Compensation
The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $150,000 - $175,000 USD per year.

Company Benefits

WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD&D, Group Legal, Identify Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)
  • Leave Benefits: Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off (includes state/local paid leave where required), Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, FMLA, ADA, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave), Paid Time Off (only included for Washington roles)
  • Retirement Benefits: Qualified contributory pension plan (if eligible) and 401(k) plan with annual nonelective company contribution. Non-qualified retirement plans available to senior level colleagues who satisfy the plans’ eligibility requirements.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

At WTW, we trust you to know your work and the people, tools and environment you need to be successful. description:
Project Process Description:

The main idea of the project is to provide interactive panoramas from street-level positions worldwide. It includes building, testing, deploying, and maintaining imagery hardware and sensors used on various platforms.

Role Overview:

The Logistics Analyst is responsible for managing equipment movement (domestic and international) throughout its lifecycle while ensuring compliance with country-specific regulations. Responsibilities include liaising with 3PL partners (e.g., FedEx, Expeditors), supporting stock management, scheduled stock counts, and forecasting.


Detailed Roles & Responsibilities:
  • Manage stock, forecasting, and supply of imagery equipment
  • Coordinate global equipment delivery and return
  • Manage and track tickets for shipments
  • Provide support for equipment purchases and logistics coordination
  • Handle hardware depot inventories
  • Oversee full product lifecycle (shipment, updates, packaging, legal clearance)
  • Ensure compliance with export/import regulations in coordination with trade compliance and 3PLs
  • Conduct or supervise warehouse inventory counts
  • Optimize inventory movement and procedures
  • Manage shipment requests and provide status updates
  • Support conflict resolution, task delegation, goal setting, and time management
  • Ensure team members have needed resources
  • Manage internal stakeholders and client communications
Candidate Qualification:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in a related field
  • 5 years in logistics, vendor or warehouse management
  • 2+ years of domain experience in Hardware Operations
  • Proficient with spreadsheets, stock management, forecasting
  • Adaptable to a fast-changing environment
  • Proficient in SAP ERP
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Team leadership and administrative task management

description:
A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independentes do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 23 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tenham ambição de fazer o impossível.

// Sobre a oportunidade

Esta oportunidade é para pessoas júniores, plenas, sêniores e especialistas que buscam atuar na área de QuantDevs na XP Inc., cujo objetivo é construir sistemas-chave relacionados a finanças quantitativas para as linhas de negócio de investimentos da XP. Este time desenvolve software para atender às demandas dinâmicas de áreas de Front Office e apoiar a tomada de decisões financeiras.

Se você atender aos requisitos mínimos das vagas , entraremos em contato através do seu e-mail para o processo seletivo. Fique atento!

Somos uma empresa em construção, onde o aprendizado é constante e você terá liberdade para criar e enfrentar muitos desafios . Além disso, trabalhará ao lado de pessoas diversas e talentosas que ajudarão a potencializar seu desempenho e gerar impacto.

Desafios que você encontrará por aqui:

  • Ambiente dinâmico e aberto a novas ideias;
  • Liberdade para construir uma carreira protagonista;
  • Espaço para desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuos.

Nossa área de tecnologia é uma das maiores da empresa, com diversas vagas e níveis de senioridade nas principais áreas.

Para saber mais sobre nossas áreas e carreiras em Tecnologia, clique aqui.

Se você se identifica com nossa cultura, embarque nessa jornada!

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Construção de sistemas de risco, posição e dados de mercado para as áreas de trading;
  • Tomada de decisões que requerem aplicação de conhecimento de negócio nos sistemas desenvolvidos;
  • Interlocução com stakeholders relevantes (Global Markets, Tesouraria, Risco de Mercado) para entender necessidades;
  • Montar ferramentas para validação de resultados dos sistemas;
  • Programação em linguagens de backend (Go, C++, Python, C#, Java, etc);
  • Conhecimento de probabilidade, estatística e cálculo;
  • Familiaridade com produtos financeiros.

>> Você pode se destacar se:

  • Já atuou em desenvolvimento quantitativo em instituições financeiras;
  • Possui sólido conhecimento de finanças quantitativas ou engenharia financeira;
  • Tem capacidade de construir sistemas financeiros com qualidade e velocidade, com autonomia.

// Sobre as etapas do processo seletivo

Triagem inicial: análise do currículo para verificar adequação às qualificações e requisitos.

Vídeo entrevista: oportunidade de nos conhecermos melhor e entender suas motivações e experiências.

Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento: discussão sobre expectativas e objetivos profissionais.

Avaliação técnica: entrevista, dinâmica ou teste focado nas habilidades específicas.

Entrevista com a liderança: conversa sobre sua visão e contribuição potencial para a equipe.

Entrevista com colegas: interação com futuros pares para avaliar sinergia e trabalho em equipe.

Entrevista cultural: exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa.

Oferta: apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo remuneração e benefícios.

"Se te oferecem um lugar em um foguete, não pergunte qual é o assento, apenas embarque."

  • Plano de saúde sem coparticipação (inclusive dependentes);

  • Licença parental: 6 meses maternidade e 20 dias paternidade;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Assessoria de Investimentos;
  • Cartão XP Visa Infinite sem anuidade;
  • Crédito (consignado, home equity, CCB Imobiliário, etc.).

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível

Nossa modalidade varia conforme a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial ou mais flexível. Seguimos um modelo com maior frequência presencial, sempre com foco em flexibilidade, autonomia e cultura empreendedora.

A valorização do contato pessoal e o uso do escritório para potencializar relações são prioridades aqui na XP Inc.

title: [Talent Pool] Investor XP | Curitiba
description:
Sobre nós

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

Nossos valores

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos, com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a oportunidade

Esta rede é direcionada a pessoas plenas e sêniores que buscam atuar como Investor na XP Inc na região de Curitiba . Temos vagas previstas para serem abertas em 2024 com diversas senioridades na estrutura. Caso seu perfil faça sentido para alguma destas vagas , entraremos em contato, convidando para avançar no processo seletivo.

Como Investor do time de Estratégia XP , você ficará responsável por trabalhar o asset allocation dos clientes de forma sofisticada, garantindo o enquadramento dos portfólios, de acordo com o suitability de cada cliente.

O Investor ocupa a posição de referência técnica para o segmento e, além de garantir a qualidade na alocação dos clientes, atua sendo interface direta com as áreas de negócio da companhia, pensando estrategicamente quais ativos devem ser trabalhados e quais perfis de cliente têm maior propensão para determinada oferta. Geram insumos comerciais para todo o time, através de treinamentos, dados, materiais, etc.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atender os principais clientes da XP, em conjunto com o Banker do cliente;
  • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento;
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;
  • Atuar no nível tático e estratégico junto às áreas que impactam direta e indiretamente o cliente final.

Pré-requisitos

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RV, RF, Fundos, Previdência, entre outros);
  • Conhecimento sobre asset allocation, enquadramento, inteligência de base;
  • Conhecimentos de macroeconomia e sua conjuntura atual;
  • Experiência atendendo clientes Private ou Alta Renda;
  • CFP ou CGA ou CFG;

Diferenciais

  • CFA ou outras certificações.

Modelo De Trabalho

  • Presencial em Curitiba e proximidades.

Benefícios Que Oferecemos

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, we’re on a mission to empower local economies — and that mission drives everything we do. What started as food delivery has evolved into a technology and logistics platform designed to help people access anything in their city, from meals to everyday essentials. We’re building the future of local commerce, and we’re looking for team members excited to be part of that journey.

Joining DoorDash means working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your ideas can shape products, impact millions of users, and help merchants, Dashers, and customers thrive. We value creativity, ownership, and continuous learning — and we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone can grow their careers while making a real difference.

We also care deeply about our team’s well-being. DoorDash offers comprehensive benefits, including premium healthcare, paid parental leave, wellness reimbursements, and more — because we believe that when our people thrive, our communities thrive too.

About the Team

DoorDash is looking for Full Stack Engineers to join our Trust & Safety team. This dedicated group is entrusted with empowering both external DoorDash customers and internal users through a comprehensive catalog of Trust and Safety features, focusing on authenticity, eligibility, compliance, and beyond.

As a Full Stack Engineer, you will collaborate closely with other high caliber engineers within an international team and cross-functional stakeholders to propel the group forward. Leveraging latest technological advancements, including Gen AI, you will build best-in-class Trust and Safety experience on one of the largest gig platforms in the world.

About the Role

Fullstack Engineers at DoorDash help design and build beautiful, intuitive user interfaces for our web applications as well as elegant backend APIs and services to create the best delivery experience possible. Product focused Engineers work at the intersection of product and infrastructure to solve key business problems with elegant technical solutions. You’ll work with both technical and business teams to build features that keep our users top of mind.

This role is hybrid with some in-office time expected and will report to an Engineering Manager.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Become a product owner for one of our client facing applications.
  • Write robust, highly tested, well-crafted code that you can be proud of.

We're excited about you because you have…

Job description

O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

  1. diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;
  2. realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;
  3. avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;
  4. programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;
  5. ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde;
  6. realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Acompanhar, analisar e tratar os relatórios e atendimentos necessários para o cumprimento das metas, prazos e melhorias.

Main responsibilities

Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.

Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina

description:
Digibee is an iPaaS that scales integration workflows while reducing cost and technical debt. Rather than require specialized integration experts, Digibee lets every developer quickly build, test, deploy, govern, and monitor integrations across on-premise and cloud environments using a simple but powerful low-code interface.

Founded in São Paulo, Brazil, in 2017 and headquartered in Weston, Florida, our team is widely distributed throughout the Americas. In May of 2023, Digibee closed a Series B funding round of $60 million that is intended to drive our expansion in the United States.

About the role

Digibee is looking to hire experienced and motivated Cloud Engineers with cloud computing and Kubernetes expertise. As a Cloud Engineer responsible for all the platform stack, you will modernize, maintain, and implement our Platform features.

On a typical day, you will…

  • Design, implement, and manage all the Kubernetes clusters of our SaaS Cloud Platform.
  • Collaborate with DevOps and software engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of applications with Kubernetes environments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to Kubernetes Network and computer networks in general.
  • Develop automation scripts and tools for deploying and managing Kubernetes Network and traditional cloud infrastructure.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior cloud engineers and DevOps team members.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to increase our platform solutions portfolio.

What you’ll need to bring…

  • Strong Information Security and Linux System administration fundamentals.

  • Good grasp on DevOps.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

It's a plus if you have…

  • Relevant certifications in Kubernetes and cloud platforms, such as CKA, CKAD, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, or Azure DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Experience with container orchestration solutions like Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service, or Google Kubernetes Engine
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools, such as GitLab CI, FluxCD

Our perks and benefits

  • Health care and Odonto Plan

Our culture

We believe in a highly collaborative work environment in order to foster constant development and exchange between teams. We encourage learning, sharing knowledge, and using new technologies to create disruptive ideas - we want to create something great together!

At Digibee, we know it's our people who make the difference. We embrace and value diversity and are dedicated to encouraging a supportive and respectful culture in our community.

We are interested in every qualified candidate eligible to work remotely in the country where this job posting is located. However, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position.

title: Implementations Project Manager, Fund Admin
description:
Implementations Project Manager, Fund Admin

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit.

Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 40,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid.

We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they’ve managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners.

At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft.

To learn more, here is what one of our investors wrote about leading our Series F.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast-growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on-boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

  • Support new Fund Administration, Portfolio Insights, and Valuations' clients by on-boarding them onto Carta – i.e., implementation of client’s limited partners list, investments, capitalization table and securities
  • Extract relevant information from operating agreements and subscription documents to upload limited partners to Carta
  • Analyze data thoroughly and precisely to maintain data integrity throughout the on-boarding process
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Investor Services teams as the bridge post-sales through implementation
  • Coordinate and manage multiple/simultaneous implementation projects by continually communicating with and motivating clients
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on-boarding process
  • Work closely with product and engineering to improve the on-boarding experience for customers

The Impact You’ll Have

You’ll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders.

About You

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem-solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world-class on-boarding experience.

  • Proven success in a project management capacity
  • Ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Experience working with financial data and information
  • Great people skills – high degree of empathy and great communication skills
  • Experience working with clients
  • Experience in implementing and successfully managing small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Passionate, tactical, and direct, with an ambitious attitude and a proven history to go above and beyond baseline requirements
  • Interested in working with enterprise software

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. If you are located in New York, New York, our minimum cash compensation salary range for this role is $81,000 - $85,000 (if applicable, + commission). We are hiring for multiple levels and locations , so final offers may vary from the amounts listed based on geography, experience and expertise, and other factors.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, connect with us via email at . As a company, we value fairness, helpfulness, transparency, leadership and build our teams around these values. Check out our careers page to get to know us better as you think about your next step at Carta.

Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. To do this, we must ask applicants and employees if they have a disability or have ever had one. People can become disabled, so we need to ask this question at least every five years.

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)
  • Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS
  • Blind or low vision
  • Cancer (past or present)
  • Cardiovascular or heart disease
  • Celiac disease
  • Cerebral palsy

  • Diabetes

description:
Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow, and inefficient financial system. Since then, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America through innovative technology and outstanding customer service. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is one of the world’s largest digital banking platforms and technology-leading companies.
Today, Nubank is a global company with offices in São Paulo (Brazil), Mexico City (Mexico), Bogotá (Colombia), Durham (United States), and Berlin (Germany). It was founded in 2013 in Sao Paulo by Colombian David Vélez, and cofounded by Brazilian Cristina Junqueira and American Edward Wible. For more information, visit .

About the role

The challenge of our Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team is to help Nubank make better financial decisions. Our mission is to understand the company’s performance from a financial perspective by analyzing past results and creating projections for the future. Broadly speaking, our team is divided into FP&A Horizontals, FP&A Markets, FP&A Global Products, FP&A Efficiency, and Procurement.

Key Responsibilities:
• Analyzing, explaining, and forecasting the financial results of the Credit Card Business Unit;
• Improving FP&A processes to generate insights and clarity in income statements, always thinking in a scalable way with reliable data;
• Understanding and analyzing the impacts of product-related decisions on the results of the Business Unit (BU);
• Automating reports by connecting them with databases from different sources;
• Building, updating, and reviewing financial models and simulators;
• Creating and presenting executive materials with financial results to the Business Unit and Leadership team.

We are looking for someone who:

• Has experience in financial analysis (P&L, Balance Sheet), credit analysis, or related areas;
• Has strong analytical skills to manage and evaluate complex data;
• Possesses strong communication skills to proactively engage with different business partners and stakeholders (Product, Finance, Markets);
• Has advanced knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets;
• Is fluent in English;
• Programming knowledge (Scala, SQL, and Python) is a plus.

  • Extended maternity and paternity Leaves
  • Child care allowance
  • Onsite Health Center - Medical support for every Nubanker in our office

Diversity and Inclusion at Nubank

We want to have a product for everyone, and we build strong and diverse teams that rise to the challenge. We are a team of the most creative people in technology, and we hire with equal opportunity, irrespective of gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or background. We are a very process-light organization that values human interactions, and that is an essential part of our culture.

title: AI Sales Engineer
description:
Role Overview

You’re the technical linchpin between our sales team and clients. As a GenAI Sales Architect, you’ll support discovery and solution-fit calls, shape compelling proposals, and ensure our GenAI offerings—across text, vision, and audio—align perfectly with client needs. Your deep expertise in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic AI, and function-calling architectures will turn opportunities into robust, future-proof solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pre-Sales Support : Participate in client workshops and sales calls to uncover requirements, map business problems to GenAI use cases, and recommend architectures.

  • Solution Design: Architect end-to-end GenAI proposals leveraging:

    • RAG Pipelines: Embedding strategies, vector stores, dynamic retrieval flows.

    • Agentic AI: Multi-agent orchestration for workflows, tool use and function calling.

    • Function-Calling: Designing safe, scalable function-execution patterns (e.g., retrieval, data enrichment, custom tool integrations).

    • Multimodal Components: Text generation & summarization, vision pipelines (OCR, image analysis), and audio services (speech-to-text, TTS, voice bots).

  • Proposal Development: Draft Statements of Work, high-level architecture diagrams, effort estimates, and risk/mitigation plans in collaboration with sales leadership.

  • Technical Evangelism: Deliver live demos and proof-of-concepts; distill complex AI concepts into clear, persuasive narratives for C-level and technical audiences.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work alongside global industry leaders to deliver and validate solution architectures, ensuring alignment with best practices and compliance standards.

  • Model Governance Advice: Recommend approaches for fine-tuning, bias mitigation, performance monitoring, and MLOps integration in client environments.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 2+ years in a pre-sales, solutions architect, or technical consulting role focused on generative AI.

  • Proven track record designing and pitching RAG-driven applications and agentic AI workflows.

  • Hands-on with function-calling patterns in LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, or similar).

  • Strong Python skills and experience integrating LLMs into production pipelines.

  • Excellent English communication and presentation skills;

Bonus Skills

  • Experience integrating GenAI into enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, or SAP.

Your deep analytical skills will guide the continuous refinement and enhancement of our platform, ensuring it operates at peak performance and maintains operational excellence. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you'll leverage your expertise to drive continuous improvement and optimization of our platform's performance metrics.

  • Market and Technology Trends Analysis: Stay abreast of emerging trends in payment technologies and industry best practices. Leverage this knowledge to recommend forward-thinking improvements and ensure the platform remains competitive and compliant with industry standards.
  • Continuous Improvement: Work with business operations team to establish and maintain processes for ongoing performance monitoring and optimization, ensuring that performance goals are consistently met.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with different teams in the company to facilitate communication and alignment on priorities related to payments performance.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams;
  • A collaborative mindset, adept at working across various teams to achieve common goals;
  • A passion for continuous learning and improvement, with a keen eye for detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving;

  • Ability to translate complex ideas into clear and intuitive product strategies;

  • Pragmatism: Value results and practical solutions;

Mit dem Laden der Karte akzeptieren Sie die Datenschutzerklärung von Google.
